address: Montessori Lyceum Amsterdam, Van Ostadestraat 103, Amsterdam (1900 school: three tall storeys of window groups between slender piers)
notes: Montessori Lyceum Amsterdam, Van Ostadestraat 103 (pand 0363100012236840, 1900, 158 LoD2.2 surfaces, roof max 20.0 m). Only the south street front has a panorama (2019-01-18 w02-168, 8.7 m away): a dark brick front of three tall storeys, each a row of window groups (two or three lights, slender white piers between) under thin stone string courses, a ground floor with a slightly lower sill, a cornice and two roof dormers. The north, east and west walls have no panorama in range and stay blank.

MODELLED: three storeys on the south panels (surfaces 13/111/112/153 and the two side panels 57/136, 97), two bays of multi-light windows per storey (windows wide), light piers and string courses, brick colour. SIMPLIFIED: the real windows are taller than the preset (about 80 % of the storey, ours 58 %); the side panels have no photo of their own and repeat the centre rhythm; the mullion detail is the plain mullion/transom grid. SKIPPED: the two roof dormers (not in the LoD2.2 roof), the MIA MAVO/HAVO sign plate and bicycle racks (temporary), the rear, side and courtyard walls (no panorama: blank).
